info.title: Stats service API V1
info.description:
### Description

This is a description of the current API of the service (used by the official website and the mobile apps). V2 aims at
replacing the current API (v1) with a more stable and documented version but both versions will be available for a
while.

### Versioning

Major changes (v2.0.0) indicate breaking changes.

Minor changes (v1.1.0) add functionality in a backward-compatible manner.

Patch changes (v1.0.1) include backward-compatible bug fixes.

The path of the endpoints will only be updated for major changes.
